description: The overall average option volume ratio is the average of the transaction-reference and trader-type combination averages.

c.request: Link each sentiment snapshot to its transaction record (`transref` = `transreg`) and that record's trader (`trdref` = `tradereg`), keeping only full matches, and compute the average option volume ratio (`optvolrt`) for each transaction reference and trader type (`tradekind`) pair. Measure each pair's deviation from the overall average option volume ratio (no rows if that's missing). Then, within each trader type, keep only the pairs whose deviation beats the type's average deviation, and note by how much (pairs with no trader type drop out at this step). For each trader type, what are the average option volume ratio, the average deviation and the average excess of those pairs? Averages ignore missing values. Don't round. The overall average option volume ratio is the average of the transaction-reference and trader-type combination averages.
c.sql:
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT t.transreg AS transref, r.tradekind, s.optvolrt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg
  JOIN trader r ON t.trdref = r.tradereg
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT transref, tradekind, AVG(optvolrt) AS pair_avg
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY transref, tradekind
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(pair_avg) AS overall_avg FROM pairs
),
dev AS (
  SELECT p.transref, p.tradekind, p.pair_avg, p.pair_avg - o.overall_avg AS deviation
  FROM pairs p
  CROSS JOIN overall o
),
type_dev AS (
  SELECT tradekind, AVG(deviation) AS type_avg_dev
  FROM dev
  WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY tradekind
),
kept AS (
  SELECT d.tradekind, d.pair_avg, d.deviation, d.deviation - td.type_avg_dev AS excess
  FROM dev d
  JOIN type_dev td ON d.tradekind = td.tradekind
  WHERE d.deviation > td.type_avg_dev
)
SELECT tradekind,
       AVG(pair_avg) AS avg_optvolrt,
       AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation,
       AVG(excess) AS avg_excess
FROM kept
GROUP BY tradekind;

a.request: Link each sentiment snapshot to its transaction record (`transref` = `transreg`) and to that record's trader (`trdref` = `tradereg`), dropping snapshots without both matches. For each combination of transaction reference (`transref`) and trader type (`tradekind`), compute the average option volume ratio (`optvolrt`). Take as the baseline the plain average of these per-combination averages, with each combination counting equally. Each combination's deviation is its average minus the baseline (no rows if the baseline is missing). Within each trader type, average those deviations. Keep only the combinations whose deviation is above their trader type's average deviation, and give each one an excess: its deviation minus the type's average deviation. Combinations with no trader type get a deviation too but are dropped at this comparison. Finally, for each trader type, report the type, the average of the kept combinations' average option volume ratios, the average of their deviations, and the average of their excess. Averages ignore missing values. No rounding.
a.sql: WITH joined AS (SELECT s.transref, tr.tradekind, s.optvolrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg), combo AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, AVG(optvolrt) AS avg_ov FROM joined GROUP BY transref, tradekind), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ov) AS base FROM combo), dev AS (SELECT c.transref, c.tradekind, c.avg_ov, c.avg_ov - b.base AS deviation FROM combo c CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE b.base IS NOT NULL), typed AS (SELECT transref, tradekind, avg_ov, deviation, AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS type_dev FROM dev WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT tradekind, avg_ov, deviation, deviation - type_dev AS excess FROM typed WHERE deviation > type_dev) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_ov) AS avg_option_volume_ratio, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(excess) AS avg_excess FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind;

b.request: For each trader type, compute the average `optvolrt` per (`transref`, `tradekind`) pair from sentiment snapshots joined to transactions and traders (full matches only), take the overall average as the mean of those pair averages, keep pairs with |pair average − overall average| as the deviation, then within each trader type keep pairs whose deviation exceeds that type's mean deviation and report the type's mean pair average, mean deviation, and mean excess (deviation minus type mean deviation) over those kept pairs, unrounded, dropping pairs with null `tradekind`
b.sql: WITH pair_avg AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS pair_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord r ON s.transref = r.transreg JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg WHERE t.tradekind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), overall AS (SELECT AVG(pair_avg) AS overall_avg FROM pair_avg), dev AS (SELECT p.tradekind, p.transref, p.pair_avg, ABS(p.pair_avg - o.overall_avg) AS deviation FROM pair_avg p CROSS JOIN overall o), type_stats AS (SELECT tradekind, AVG(deviation) AS type_mean_dev FROM dev GROUP BY tradekind), kept AS (SELECT d.tradekind, d.pair_avg, d.deviation, d.deviation - ts.type_mean_dev AS excess FROM dev d JOIN type_stats ts ON d.tradekind = ts.tradekind WHERE d.deviation > ts.type_mean_dev) SELECT tradekind, AVG(pair_avg) AS mean_pair_avg, AVG(deviation) AS mean_deviation, AVG(excess) AS mean_excess FROM kept GROUP BY tradekind;

d.request: Link each sentiment snapshot to its transaction record (`transref` = `transreg`) and that record's trader (`trdref` = `tradereg`), keeping only full matches. Compute the average option volume ratio (`optvolrt`) for each transaction reference and trader type (`tradekind`) pair. Define the overall average option volume ratio as the average of those pair averages. Measure each pair's deviation from that overall average, and produce no rows if it is missing. Within each trader type, keep only the pairs whose deviation exceeds the type's average deviation, and note by how much (pairs with no trader type drop out at this step). For each trader type, what are the average option volume ratio, the average deviation, and the average excess of those pairs? Averages ignore missing values, and results are not rounded.
d.sql:
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT t.transreg AS transref, tr.tradekind, s.optvolrt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg
  JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg
),
pair_avg AS (
  SELECT transref, tradekind, AVG(optvolrt) AS pair_avg
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY transref, tradekind
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(pair_avg) AS overall_avg FROM pair_avg
),
dev AS (
  SELECT p.transref, p.tradekind, p.pair_avg, ABS(p.pair_avg - o.overall_avg) AS deviation
  FROM pair_avg p
  CROSS JOIN overall o
  WHERE p.pair_avg IS NOT NULL AND o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
),
typed AS (
  SELECT d.tradekind, d.pair_avg, d.deviation,
         AVG(d.deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY d.tradekind) AS type_avg_dev
  FROM dev d
  WHERE d.tradekind IS NOT NULL
),
kept AS (
  SELECT tradekind, pair_avg, deviation, deviation - type_avg_dev AS excess
  FROM typed
  WHERE deviation > type_avg_dev
)
SELECT tradekind,
       AVG(pair_avg) AS avg_optvolrt,
       AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation,
       AVG(excess) AS avg_excess
FROM kept
GROUP BY tradekind;
